),
per_gene AS (
  SELECT ensg, COUNT(*) AS n_donors, median(lr) AS med, MIN(lr) AS mn, MAX(lr) AS mx,
         AVG(CASE WHEN lr>0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS frac_pos
  FROM lr GROUP BY ensg
),
agg AS (

  FROM rna_immune_cell GROUP BY 1
),
